content:
Why inventory still breaks on busy clinic days

When pharmacy stock lives in spreadsheets separate from prescriptions and billing, teams discover gaps only when a patient is waiting at the counter. That is the wrong moment to learn a SKU is expired or miscounted.

Core workflows to digitize first

  • Receive stock: batch number, expiry, supplier, and cost price
  • Dispense against prescriptions: auto-deduct quantities from the correct batch
  • Expiry alerts: 30/60/90-day warnings before write-offs
  • Reorder thresholds: minimum levels per fast-moving SKU

Daily controls that prevent surprises

  1. Reconcile dispensed items with invoices at shift end
  2. Review near-expiry list every Monday
  3. Tag high-value items for monthly physical counts
  4. Track returns and adjustments with reasons

Link pharmacy to clinical and financial data

When inventory connects to EMR and billing, you can see margin by medicine category, identify prescribing patterns, and reduce manual reconciliation between the dispensary and accounts team.

ClinicPro pharmacy and inventory modules are designed for in-clinic dispensaries that need speed at the counter and accuracy in reports.
